text:
Jamal (Support): FYI - Arborlane onboarding is stuck at provisioning step. customer sees 403 when we call /v1/provision and UI shows ""Waiting for keys"" :grimacing:
Maya (CS Ops): Oh no. Renewal check-in in 12 days, right? that timeline makes this high priority :exclamation:
Jamal (Support): Correct. Ticket #67891. Error sample from logs:
```
2026-03-20T15:02:11Z ERROR provision failed status=403 body={"error":"invalid_key_scope"}
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/provision -d '{"tenant":"arborlane"}'
```
Sophia (CSM): Arborlane is on Growth plan, seat-based renewal on 2026-04-01. If we miss onboarding they may bump to paused renewal discussion. We need a comms plan before EOD. :alarm_clock:
Maya (CS Ops): Proposed comms plan: 1) send immediate acknowledgement to customer w/ ETA (Jamal), 2) escalate to infra eng for key-scope fix (Alex), 3) daily status digest to customer+acct team until resolved (Sophia), 4) offer temporary bypass tokens for onboarding if safe (ops decision).
Jamal (Support): Acknowledgement drafted: ""We're on it, investigating provisioning scope mismatch. ETA 4 hours, will update sooner."" ok to send?
Sophia (CSM): Send now. add note we have an engineer assigned and we will call customer if not resolved in 2 hours.
Alex S (Eng): I'm looking. initial hunch: token provisioning service recently had a policy change that tightened scopes for embed_provision. reproducing locally. assigning myself P0.
Alex S (Eng): quick workaround available: create a temporary scoped token with scope set to ["provision:onboard"] and restrict to arborlane tenant. I can generate if CS approves.
Maya (CS Ops): Approval from CS: Sophia ok with temporary token?
Sophia (CSM): Yes, approve limited-scope temp token. add note in audit log and rotate after onboarding.
ProvisionBot: Automated note: Temporary token generation request logged (#temp-req-842). Audit trail created.
Jamal (Support): Sent ack to Arborlane. they replied ""Thanks — please keep us posted, we have a kickoff demo tomorrow."" :eyes:
Alex S (Eng): Pushed fix to staging, retired old scope check. patch awaiting canary test (15m). I'll post results.
Maya (CS Ops): Action items:
- Jamal: paste convo + ticket link into CS handoff doc (owner: Jamal)
- Alex: if canary passes, promote to prod and create temp token only if needed (owner: Alex)
- Sophia: prep renewal note to mention mitigation (owner: Sophia)
- Maya: schedule 10am bridge with customer and eng if still unresolved (owner: Maya)
Jamal (Support): Done — handoff doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/handoffs/67891 (added logs and ack email)
Alex S (Eng): Canary passed. promoting to prod in 3m. I'll post release id.
Alex S (Eng): Prod deploy complete. Verified provision call returns 200 and key created. Sample response:
```
{"status":"ok","tenant":"arborlane","key_id":"k_prod_8f3"}
```
Jamal (Support): Confirmed with customer - onboarding resumed and keys show up in UI. They ran first import successfully. :tada:
Sophia (CSM): Great job team. I'll send renewal status update to account exec and add note to renewal playbook to flag provisioning regressions earlier.
Maya (CS Ops): Closing loop: please add postmortem bullet points to ticket and set follow-up for a runbook update. I'll own the runbook action.
Jamal (Support): Adding postmortem notes now. timeline and root cause + mitigation steps included.
Sophia (CSM): I'll follow up with Arborlane tomorrow to ensure kickoff went well and capture any enablement feedback for docs.
Maya (CS Ops): Thanks all. keeping this in urgent queue until renewal date passes. :handshake:
